title: Fill a gear order and hand it to the Portfolio Manager
purpose: Every new site gets a whole kit on the day the schedule names. Every phone in it is enrolled, tested, and signed for.
with: the Digital Infrastructure Lead, who enrolls the phones, and the Portfolio Manager, who signs for the kit
when: The day the gear order is written, until the handover on launch day.
takes: The same week from the store. One to two weeks if phones must be bought.

steps.do: Read the order and write the full kit list
steps.time: The day the order is written
steps.detail: Phones, spares at 10%, mounts, caps, chargers, a strip, labels, signage, and the forms. One kit per ten phones.
steps.check: The list has a count for every item.

steps.do: Count the store against the list
steps.who: You, at the Central Cairo warehouse
steps.detail: What is short, order the same day. Phones take one to two weeks.
steps.check: You know today whether the date holds.

steps.do: Enroll every phone in the MDM and tag it
steps.detail: A phone we cannot see on the map does not join a kit. Open its registry row.
steps.check: Every phone shows on the map with its tag.

steps.do: Run one 30-minute test recording on every phone
steps.detail: Watch it upload. A phone that does not upload does not join the kit.
steps.check: Every phone shows one completed upload.

steps.do: Build the kit, label everything, and pack it
steps.time: Before the phones leave the store
steps.detail: Device numbers on the phones, the site on the bags, nothing written on the outside of a bag.
steps.check: The kit matches the list, item by item.

steps.do: Sign the kit out of the store
steps.who: You sign it out. The person carrying it to the site signs for it.
steps.check: The registry shows every phone as out of the store and in a named person's hands.

steps.do: Hand the kit to the Portfolio Manager and count it together
steps.who: The person who carried the kit, with the Portfolio Manager
steps.detail: Count by device number. Both sign the phone list.
steps.check: The Portfolio Manager signed for the whole kit.

steps.do: Update the registry and refill the spare pool
steps.detail: Every phone is now at the site in the Portfolio Manager's name. Reorder anything under 10% the same week.
steps.check: The map and the registry match the site. The spare pool is at 10%.

done: The Portfolio Manager signed for the whole kit on the day the schedule named. Every phone in it is on the map.

fails.if: The store is short and phones will land late
fails.then: Launch day moves. No site launches short. Tell Moharam the same day and move the line on the dispatch schedule.

fails.if: A phone will not enroll or never shows on the map
fails.then: It does not join a kit. Set it aside for repair and take another phone.

fails.if: A bag goes missing between the store and the site
fails.then: Call Moharam now. The Digital Infrastructure Lead puts every phone on the list in lost mode within the hour.

fails.if: The Portfolio Manager's count is not your count
fails.then: Nobody signs. Find the device number behind the difference before anyone leaves.
Order the same day. Take the missing phones off the dispatch schedule so it does not count on phones that are not there.

escalate: Moharam the same day for a launch that will not hold or a lost phone.
